messages:
anna-sec: Heads up — Citrine (private deploy) reported keystore-agent crash loops after kernel + CVE patch this morning. Audit forwarding stopped around the same time. Locking thread to coordinate mitigations.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0412 created (severity: high) — oncall paging initiated.

sam-devops: what agent image/version are we running in that cluster?

anna-sec: keystore-agent v1.3.8 (priv-agent bundle), image sha: sha256:7a1b2c3d. Crash loop with SIGKILL. Partial log snippet:
```
2026-04-12T20:59:12Z I starting keystore-agent v1.3.8
2026-04-12T21:02:47Z E failed decrypt: runtime error: invalid memory address or nil pointer dereference
2026-04-12T21:02:47Z F panic: runtime error: invalid memory address
```

alok-mlinfra: that stack looks like a nil deref in the KMS shim when HSM reply is empty. Could be TLS handshake failing or unexpected payload. Any network policy changes last night?

maria-sre: yes — we tightened egress netpol for tenant plane at 20:45 UTC, limited outbound to 10.0.4.12:443 only. I see the HSM IP rotated to 10.0.5.14 during maintenance at 20:55. Likely blocked.

jenna-audit: Audit events stop at 21:03 UTC. No decrypt errors were forwarded because agent dies before writing full event. We need to snapshot whatever logs we have now.

sam-devops: Agreed. Proposed immediate mitigations (short list):
1) Re-open egress to 10.0.5.14:443 and allow 10.0.4.12:443
2) Roll back keystore-agent to v1.3.7 (last-known-good) while we triage v1.3.8
3) Increase agent replica to 3 during rollback window for stability, then scale to desired
4) Create an ephemeral RBAC role `keystore-diagnostics-emergency` scoped to namespace for 2h only
5) Enable debug logging and forward logs to secure bucket (read-only for audit) for 1 hour

sam-devops: kubectl snippets I'm about to run:
```bash
# reopen netpol egress rule
kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: allow-hsm-egress-temp
  namespace: redwood-tenant-citrine
spec:
  podSelector: {}
  policyTypes: ["Egress"]
  egress:
  - to:
    - ipBlock:
        cidr: 10.0.5.14/32
      ports:
      - protocol: TCP
        port: 443
EOF

# roll back image
kubectl -n redwood-tenant-citrine set image deploy/keystore-agent keystore-agent=priv/keystore-agent:1.3.7
```

anna-sec: RBAC change needs approval from sec leads. We'll approve an emergency policy that auto-expires in 2 hours. @jenna-audit please ensure the audit snapshot is write-once and access-limited.

jenna-audit: On it. Snapshotting logs now and copying to s3://private-audit-snapshots/Citrine/2026-04-12/ (access: sec+audit only). Also enabling Splunk backfill for the 21:00-22:00 window.

maria-sre: FYI there's also a glibc/OpenSSL ABI note in the vendor advisory for v1.3.8 — some kernels + userland combos cause libcrypto to return empty blob on decrypt. Reproducing in staging with same kernel will be important.

alok-mlinfra: For medium/long term: add a decrypt circuit breaker returning 503 instead of panic; agent should surface a degraded error (so callers can fall back) and not crash the pod. I'll open RFC and a PR to change panic -> error path. Also recommend healthcheck that fails ready but keeps container up so we can debug.

sam-devops: Starting mitigation now. Posting updates: 21:05 UTC — applying netpol change. 21:08 UTC — rolling image to 1.3.7.

sam-devops: 21:12 UTC — rollback complete, pods stable, no crash loops. Audit forwarding resumed at 21:13:02. Monitoring for 30m.

jenna-audit: Received snapshot files and restricted access is in place. Creating ticket AU-2026-221 to track retention/forensics.

anna-sec: Good. Action items assigned: @sam-devops (mitigation + post-rollback health check), @jenna-audit (forensics + retention), @alok-mlinfra (code fix + RFC), @maria-sre (staging repro). I'll draft a short customer-facing incident note and request a maintenance window for the vendor patching. :lock:

sam-devops: Customer notified (msg sent at 21:25 UTC). We'll propose 2-hour maintenance tomorrow to apply vendor patch and upgrade agent with safe fallback.

anna-sec: We'll keep this incident open until 2 hours of no regressions post-rollback. If no issues, we'll convert to a postmortem channel + documentation of compensating controls.

sam-devops: 21:40 UTC — 35m monitoring, metrics look normal, no new crashes.

anna-sec: Thanks team. Closing loop when we hit 2h stable. Please avoid further netpol changes in that namespace until the patch is applied.

sam-devops: Noted.

jenna-audit: Postmortem ticket created PM-2026-88, assigned to anna-sec + sam-devops + alok-mlinfra.

anna-sec: Closing this thread for day-to-day chatter; move postmortem discussion to PM channel when ready.
